messages:
Alex: Quick heads up — PR #8421 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff at 02:00 UTC for hotfix v1.2.3. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8421 :eyes:
Priya: Thanks Alex — can you add a short changelog blurb? I can approve after that.
Alex: Added changelog in the PR description. TL;DR: reduce kv-cache prewarm to avoid OOMs on p4d.
Sam: I can give one LGTM, running smoke locally now.
Taylor: pinging from EST — I can be the second eye if Sam's smoke passes. What should I focus on?
Sam: Focus on mem use + canary start sequence. I hit one flake in warmup but looks unrelated.
Taylor: Got it. If smoke passes I'll approve.
Alex: Awesome. Deploy schedule: canary at 02:10 UTC, full roll at 02:40 UTC. If we don't have 2x LGTM by 02:00 UTC we hold and cut a rollback plan.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for v1.2.3 at 2025-11-08T02:10:00Z (canary-id: c-20251108-01).
Priya: One request: add `--kv-prewarm-size=0.5` to the runtime args in the manifest (small change in the PR).
Alex: Done — pushed a small manifest tweak.
Sam: Running `make smoke-test` now, output looks clean so far:
```
$ git fetch origin pull/8421/head:pr8421
$ make smoke-test
INFO: starting runtime
PASS: smoke: kv-warmup ok
PASS: smoke: inference latency nominal
```
Taylor: ✅ I reviewed the manifest and smoke logs — LGTM from me.
Sam: LGTM from me too.
Alex: Fantastic, this gives us 2x LGTM before cutoff. Proceed with canary at 02:10 UTC. Thanks everyone. :tada:
Oncall Ops: Noted. I'll monitor traces and escalate if errors spike above 5% during canary.
Priya: Adding a note to the rollout doc with rollback steps and owner (Oncall Ops).
Alex: Will follow up with post-canary checklist.
thread_summary: Hotfix PR #8421 needed two approvals before 02:00 UTC cutoff; quick smoke tests and manifest tweak; deploy scheduled and oncall assigned to monitor.
